The issuer exhibits very strong operating performance with high profitability (85% gross margin and 32% operating margin) and substantial revenue of 20,880M. However, its balance sheet shows high leverage (total liabilities of 274,899M against assets of 308,894M) and a very weak liquidity profile, highlighted by a current ratio of only 0.35 (current assets of 56,524M versus current liabilities of 159,640M). While the massive operating income supports debt servicing, the significant short-term funding mismatch and leveraged capital structure position this issuer in the speculative-grade category, albeit at the upper end due to its strong earnings power.

DECISION: BB-
